capabilities: Navigate notes in a tree built from a parent-link property
Link or unlink the active note as a child of any note in the navigator
Pin and switch the root note and browse root file history
Open notes in the active tab, a new tab, or a new section
Configure the parent property name and note title source
disambiguation: Not a folder manager; it abandons folders entirely and derives the tree from a customizable parent-link property between notes.
extras: README links to a development roadmap elsewhere; installation is manual via a downloaded release.
problem: Obsidian's file navigator confines each note to one folder, so a note cannot belong to several hierarchies at once.
summary: Navigation plugin that builds a note hierarchy from a parent-link property, letting notes appear in multiple tree locations instead of folders.
